ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which is the pollen-producing reproductive organ of a flower?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is “Parts of a Plant”, showing the structure of a flower. Visible labels include Petal, Sepal, Stem, Stigma, Style, Ovary, Eggs, Anther, and Stamen. In the image, the “Stamen” label points to the slender male structures inside the flower, and the “Anther” label points to the brown parts at the tips of these structures. Reasoning: In biology, the stamen (雄蕊) is the male reproductive organ of a flower; the anther (花药) is the part of the stamen that produces pollen. The question asks for the “reproductive organ that produces pollen”, not the separate pollen-producing tip structure, so the answer should be stamen.
